narrative: On the part. The part lies unrolled on the bed in the shared chamber, one line at the head of it, the rest of the leaf below your hand and not in the reading. A paper crown sits on the cloak, not on a head. On the part. The finger stays under that one line. The old velvet is folded at the edge of the bed. No second line is taken up.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the entrance line once, and did not add another.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
